guide.summary: Dark-and-light water under a closed lid, with a rich patch in the middle.
guide.biology: When light fades, life that does not depend on it keeps feeding on what others leave behind.
guide.rules: All water; no stones; no shade. Metabolite 0.20 and nutrient 0.10 in a circle of radius 14 at (64,64). Light 0.8, warmth 0.5, oxygen 0.8, carbon dioxide 0.5, nutrient 0.10 and sugar 0.02 everywhere else. Lid closed; light cycles between day and night.
guide.example: Watch the middle patch through a night and see what changes there.
